title: Cryogenic thermal properties (NIST Cryogenic Technologies Group fits)
licence:
Source: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Cryogenic Technologies Group, https://trc.nist.gov/cryogenics/materials/materialproperties.htm. Changed by SlideRule: NIST publishes polynomial fit coefficients, not tables. SlideRule evaluated each fit at 60 log-spaced temperatures inside the range covered by both NIST's data and its equation, rounded the results to 6 significant figures and stores them as a curve that is interpolated between those points (PCHIP). Only thermal conductivity and specific heat are used. Built 2026-11-05.
